home.heroText: A garden hotel on the Huye–Tumba road. Quiet rooms, a warm table and room to gather.
home.introTitle: Comfort, nature and a quiet kind of excellence.
home.introText: Arboretum Green Hotel is a garden hotel on the Huye–Tumba road. We keep an unhurried pace: calm mornings, honest food, rooms that let you sleep.

doors.stay: Four room types, each calm and carefully kept.
doors.dine: Restaurant, bar and coffee bar, from first light to late.
doors.meet: A hall for conferences, weddings and family occasions.
doors.discover: Arboretum walks, Kibeho Holy Land, Nyungwe by day.

home.eveningTitle: When the lights come on, the garden goes quiet.
home.eveningText: Dinner under the slatted ceiling, a drink at the bar, a last coffee on the terrace.
home.contactText: Write on WhatsApp or call. A person at reception answers, not a machine.

stay.title: Rooms to rest in.
stay.text: Four kinds of room, all with private bathrooms, fresh linen every day and quiet nights.

dine.title: A warm table, morning to night.
dine.text: Three rooms under one roof: a restaurant for long meals, a bar for the evening, a coffee bar for the morning.
dine.kitchenText: Everything leaves a kitchen we would be happy to show you. Tell us about allergies or preferences when you book.

meet.title: Room to gather.
meet.text: Conferences, weddings, graduations and family occasions, hosted with the same care as a single guest.
meet.quoteText: Share the date, the number of guests and what you need. We will send a proposal within one working day.

discover.title: Stay a day longer.
discover.text: Huye is Rwanda's university town and its cultural heart. These are the places our guests ask about most.
discover.nameText: Bamboo along the terrace, plants at every door, a lawn under the string lights. The garden is how we slow the day down for you.

privacySections: Arboretum Green Hotel, Huye–Tumba Road, Huye, Rwanda, is responsible for the personal data collected on this website. Contact: arboretumgreenhotel@gmail.com or +250 781 600 065.
Only what you choose to send us: your name, phone, email, dates, number of guests and message when you use the enquiry form, and the content of WhatsApp messages you send to reception.
To answer your request, confirm and manage your stay, table or event, and keep the records the law requires. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

Your browser keeps a small note of how you found us (for example Google or Instagram) for 30 days. It adds a short reference such as AG-G-7K2Q to your message so we know which channel works. It contains nothing that identifies you.
We count page visits with privacy-friendly analytics that use no cookies and store no personal data.
WhatsApp (Meta) carries your WhatsApp messages; our email provider delivers form enquiries; the map on the contact page is provided by Google, which may set its own cookies when you use it.

Under Rwanda's law on the protection of personal data and privacy (Law No. 058/2021), you can ask to see, correct or delete your data, or object to its use. Write to us at the email above and we will answer within 30 days.
termsSections: Rates are shown in Rwandan francs and can be quoted in US dollars. The rate confirmed to you in writing for your booking is the one that applies.
A 50% deposit confirms your booking. We accept MTN MoMo, Visa, Mastercard, cash and bank transfer.
You can cancel free of charge up to 2 hours before your planned arrival time. After that, the deposit may be kept.
Check-out is by 10:00. The check-in time is confirmed with your booking.
Event bookings, menus and hall hire are confirmed in a separate written quote.
We keep the information on this site accurate, but details such as menus and hours can change. Please confirm anything important with reception.
